content.text: What You Can Actually Get Done Today

Today, you can establish a fully operational online store that accepts cryptocurrency payments. Using tools like Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments, you can deploy an e-commerce platform with minimal effort. Begin by setting up a GitHub Pages site for hosting your products. Next, integrate a payment processor that accepts cryptocurrencies like USDT on the Tron network, which settles transactions in under 60 seconds for a fee of less than $0.10. This straightforward setup enables you to start selling digital products immediately.
The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

The Sovereign Starter Stack is your best option for a quick launch. For just $97, you get a deployment that includes GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for payment processing. This combination supports three products and provides 30 days of support. With this stack, you can accept payments in multiple cryptocurrencies without relying on traditional banking systems, ensuring that your income is secure and accessible from anywhere in Cameroon.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

Focus on what matters for deployment. Start with the essential components: hosting your site and setting up payment processing. Avoid getting bogged down in advanced features like SEO optimization or extensive marketing strategies at this stage. Concentrate on onboarding customers and processing payments. Once your system is live and functioning, you can refine your marketing approach and explore additional features to enhance your store's performance.
Your digital store can be live in under 48 hours.
Getting Your First Transaction Live

To process your first payment, ensure that your product is ready for sale and your payment processor is integrated correctly. Share your product link with potential customers, guiding them on how to make a payment using their preferred cryptocurrency. The instant payment confirmation from NOWPayments will trigger delivery of the digital product automatically. This seamless transaction process ensures that your customers have a smooth purchasing experience, establishing trust and encouraging repeat business.
What to Do in the Next 24 Hours

In the next 24 hours, finalize your product listings and test your payment processing setup. Use the tools provided in the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to access templates and blueprints that will streamline the process. Promote your digital products on social media platforms where your audience is active. Reach out to your network to generate initial sales and gather feedback on your purchasing process. This proactive approach will solidify your presence in the market.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

Global access through sovereign infrastructure works because every layer of the stack is geography-neutral by design. Cloudflare Pages serves your storefront from data centers close to your buyer — whether they are in London or Lagos, the page loads in under 200 milliseconds. NOWPayments generates a unique payment address for each transaction — the buyer sends crypto from any wallet, anywhere in the world. The blockchain confirms the transaction regardless of which country the sender is in. Your Cloudflare Worker receives the webhook and processes the order using the same logic for every buyer.
Accept payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies with low fees.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to sell digital products effectively, explore related searches on how to build your store with tools like Cloudflare and NOWPayments. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) contains everything you need to deploy your system, ensuring you can accept payments seamlessly. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more details.
Your Deployment Checklist

Open a self-custody wallet — Trust Wallet or MetaMask — and back up the seed phrase before configuring anything else. Create your NOWPayments account and configure the self-custody wallet addresses as your payout destination. Open a Binance account and complete enough P2P setup to verify you can convert USDT to your local currency. Deploy your stack and configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint. Build your product pages with USD prices and confirm the checkout generates QR codes and live price feeds correctly. Run a mainnet test transaction from a second wallet to confirm the full pipeline. Do a test P2P conversion with a small amount of USDT to confirm the conversion process works end-to-end. Promote your store.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I sell digital products in Cameroon without PayPal?
You can sell digital products in Cameroon by using cryptocurrency payment processors like NOWPayments. This allows you to accept payments in various cryptocurrencies, bypassing the need for PayPal.
What are the best payment methods for digital sales in Nigeria?
In Nigeria, utilize Binance P2P for local currency transactions and NOWPayments for cryptocurrency sales. This combination ensures you can reach both local and international customers effectively.
Can I use USDT to sell products from Pakistan?
Yes, you can use USDT on the Tron network for transactions from Pakistan. It offers quick settlements and low fees, making it an ideal choice for digital product sales.
Is it possible to sell ebooks without traditional payment gateways?
Absolutely. By using blockchain payment processors like NOWPayments, you can sell ebooks directly to customers without needing traditional gateways, ensuring full control over your sales process.
What infrastructure do I need to start selling digital products?
To start selling digital products, set up a website using GitHub Pages, integrate a payment processor like NOWPayments, and ensure you have a delivery mechanism for your digital files.
No subscriptions or dependencies on third-party platforms.
